partners.mechanism_chain: BUB1B (HGNC:1397) —DISRUPTS→ Mitotic Spindle Assembly and Function (GO:0000280); ANAPC7 (HGNC:19808) —DISRUPTS→ Anaphase Promoting Complex (APC/C) activity (GO:0042119); Mitotic Spindle Assembly and Function (GO:0000280) —LEADS_TO→ Premature chromatid separation (HP:0001744); Anaphase Promoting Complex (APC/C) activity (GO:0042119) —LEADS_TO→ Neurodevelopmental delay (HP:0001263); BUB1B (HGNC:1397) —BINDS→ Anaphase Promoting Complex (APC/C) activity (GO:0042119); ANAPC7 (HGNC:19808) —BINDS→ Mitotic Spindle Assembly and Function (GO:0000280). Loss-of-function mutations in BUB1B disrupt mitotic spindle assembly and function, leading to premature chromatid separation. BUB1B also interacts with the Anaphase Promoting Complex (APC/C). Concurrently, loss-of-function mutations in ANAPC7 disrupt the activity of the APC/C complex. Dysregulation of the APC/C contributes to broader cellular defects that manifest as neurodevelopmental delay. The shared interaction between BUB1B and the APC/C complex, along with the direct disruption of APC/C by ANAPC7, provides a mechanistic link.
